rule: start every projection at 2 bits; at each step consider every upgrade of every projection from its current bit width to any higher width in {3, 4, 8} (2->8 directly allowed) whose calibration MSE reduction mse[b_current] - mse[b_new] is positive and whose extra packed bytes keep the total at or under the budget; take the upgrade with the largest reduction / extra bytes, ties broken by module name ascending then the smaller target width; stop when no such upgrade exists. Packed bytes come from the same byte function as Q2/Q3 (payload, group metadata, serialized scales, excluded FP16).
scales: Q2 INT4 alphas and INT4 fold/store plan at every bit width; only the bit width changes
selection_data: calibration only; no test file was open when this map was written
sensitivity_definition: calibration output MSE of the original-space AWQ reconstruction of each projection at each b in {2, 3, 4, 8}, with that projection's frozen Q2 INT4 alpha; the INT4 entry is the alpha-search optimum
